description: Send an inquiry to Novaeon on behalf of a person (same as the contact form; they reply by email). Only call this when the person asked to contact Novaeon and agreed to share their name and email. Rate limited.

consent.description: Must be true: the person agrees Novaeon stores these details to answer (https://novaeon.studio/privacy).

email.description: Email address Novaeon should reply to

language.description: Preferred language code, e.g. en, ro, de (optional)

message.description: What they need (project, problem, questions). At least 10 characters.

name: submit_inquiry
title: Contact Novaeon
